description: Contract for the run quality gate output (implementation spec section 3.2, lines 615-697). Produced by src/authorized_assessment/quality/run_quality_gate.py with a dependency-free subset validator. Any gate condition forbids quality_status=VALID and forbids a negative ('no vulnerabilities found') conclusion.

status_semantics.VALID: No gate condition triggered and no degradation signal; the only state that may allow negative_conclusion_allowed=true.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: No gate condition triggered, but sub-threshold degradation signals exist (transport errors, WAF blocks, or rate-limit skips).
status_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: At least one mandatory gate condition triggered; negative conclusions are forbidden.
status_semantics.FAILED: No in-scope target ever returned a successful response; the run cannot support any conclusion.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: The run is explicitly blocked (stop condition, approval gate, or scope not confirmed).

gate_threshold_notes.waf_block_ratio_max: The spec only requires a configurable WAF/block threshold; 0.1 is the documented conservative default and may be overridden by callers.

metric_definitions.probe_coverage: unique in-scope targets with at least one successful probe / unique in-scope targets; clamped to [0,1]; duplicate counting above 1.0 is forbidden
metric_definitions.probe_ok_ratio: probe rows with ok=true / total probe rows; clamped to [0,1]
metric_definitions.transport_error_ratio: probe rows with error_class in transport classes (dns, timeout, connection) / total probe rows
metric_definitions.waf_block_ratio: probe rows with error_class=waf / total probe rows

invariants: negative_conclusion_allowed must be true if and only if quality_status == VALID
quality_gate_reasons must be non-empty for every state other than VALID
credential-like keys are forbidden anywhere in the payload
